security.csp: default-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost; img-src 'self' data: asset: http://asset.localhost; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; font-src 'self' data:; script-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'

bundle.shortDescription: Offline invoicing for freelancers and small businesses
bundle.longDescription: Ledgerly is a fully local, fully offline invoicing app. Manage clients, create invoices and estimates, track payments, run reports and export professional PDFs, with no account, no cloud and no network dependency. Your data stays in one folder on your own machine. Every feature is free, and the source is yours to read and change under the MIT licence.
